turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Mr. Patil, I am Rohan from the secure banking department. I am calling regarding a synchronization error with your mobile app account based in Nagpur.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hello? What error? Everything was working fine yesterday.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a backend server issue, sir, but if not fixed, your account will be frozen. I just need you to download a small tool called AnyDesk so I can guide you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: AnyDesk? I do not know this. Is this safe to put on my phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, it is completely official for remote assistance. Just open the app and tell me the nine digit code appearing on your screen.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, wait one minute. The number is 452 109 832.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, I have access now. I can see the glitch, and to reactivate the link, you need to make a verification transfer of eighty thousand rupees to our secure node.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Eighty thousand? Why do I need to send money to fix a server error?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is not a charge, sir, it is a security deposit that will be refunded immediately. Please open your UPI app and enter the amount now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am not sure about this. Let me call my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, if you hang up now, the account will be permanently blocked. Just give me your login PIN and I will handle the transfer for you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But my bank says never to share the PIN with anyone.
